// Kartenspiel Online-Server – alles in dieser einen Datei.
// Start: node server.txt   (Port kommt vom Hoster, lokal 3000)
// Online-Server für das Kartenspiel. Nur eingebaute Node.js-Module, keine Pakete nötig.
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const E = (function () {
const module = { exports: {} };
// Spiellogik ohne Oberfläche. Wird vom Server genutzt (und kann im Browser geladen werden).
(function (root, factory) {
  const api = factory();
  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = api;
  else root.KartenEngine = api;
})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : this, function () {
  const RANKS = ['2', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '10', 'B', 'D', 'K', '3', 'A'];
  const SUITS = ['♠', '♥', '♦', '♣'];

  const strength = r => RANKS.indexOf(r);
  const sortHand = h => h.sort((a, b) => strength(b.r) - strength(a.r)); // stärkste zuerst
  const emptyPile = () => ({ cards: [], count: 0, rank: null, last: null });
  const fresh = name => ({ name, hand: [], finished: false, exInfo: { got: [], gave: [] } });

  function buildDeck() {
    const d = [];
    for (const s of SUITS) for (const r of RANKS) d.push({ r, s });
    return d;
  }
  function shuffle(a) {
    for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
    }
    return a;
  }
  function validIdx(idxs, len) {
    if (!Array.isArray(idxs) || idxs.length === 0) return false;
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const i of idxs) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(i) || i < 0 || i >= len || seen.has(i)) return false;
      seen.add(i);
    }
    return true;
  }

  function newEngine(names) {
    return {
      players: names.map(fresh), round: 0, lastRanking: null, phase: 'lobby',
      current: null, pile: emptyPile(), pass: 0, finishOrder: [], exQueue: [], ranking: null, msg: ''
    };
  }

  // Index des Spielers, der gerade handeln muss (oder null)
  function actor(G) {
    if (!G) return null;
    if (G.phase === 'exchange') return G.exQueue[0].from;
    if (G.phase === 'play') return G.current;
    return null;
  }

  function nextActive(G, i) {
    const n = G.players.length;
    for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
      const j = (i + k) % n;
      if (!G.players[j].finished) return j;
    }
    return i;
  }

  function countOthers(G) {
    return G.players.filter((p, i) => !p.finished && i !== G.pile.last).length;
  }

  function startPlay(G, s) {
    G.phase = 'play'; G.pile = emptyPile(); G.pass = 0; G.current = s;
  }

  function startRound(G) {
    const n = G.players.length;
    G.round++;
    G.players.forEach(p => { p.hand = []; p.finished = false; p.exInfo = { got: [], gave: [] }; });
    shuffle(buildDeck()).forEach((c, i) => G.players[i % n].hand.push(c));
    G.players.forEach(p => sortHand(p.hand));
    G.finishOrder = []; G.ranking = null; G.pile = emptyPile(); G.pass = 0; G.exQueue = [];
    if (G.lastRanking) {
      doAutoExchange(G);
    } else {
      const s = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
      G.msg = `Runde ${G.round}: ${G.players[s].name} beginnt.`;
      startPlay(G, s);
    }
  }

  // Neue Spieler stehen unten, in Beitrittsreihenfolge (später = weiter unten).
  function nextRound(G, newNames) {
    const old = G.players.length;
    newNames.forEach(nm => G.players.push(fresh(nm)));
    G.lastRanking = [...G.ranking, ...newNames.map((_, k) => old + k)];
    startRound(G);
  }

  // ---- Tausch ----
  function takeBest(G, from, to, k) {
    const P = G.players;
    const cards = P[from].hand.splice(0, k);
    P[to].hand.push(...cards);
    P[from].exInfo.gave.push({ who: P[to].name, cards });
    P[to].exInfo.got.push({ who: P[from].name, cards });
    sortHand(P[to].hand); sortHand(P[from].hand);
  }

  function doAutoExchange(G) {
    const R = G.lastRanking, n = R.length;
    const F = R[0], S2 = R[1], V = R[n - 2], L = R[n - 1];
    takeBest(G, L, F, 2);
    takeBest(G, V, S2, 1);
    G.exQueue = [{ from: F, to: L, count: 2 }, { from: S2, to: V, count: 1 }];
    G.phase = 'exchange';
    G.msg = `Tausch: ${G.players[L].name} gibt ${G.players[F].name} die 2 besten Karten, ${G.players[V].name} gibt ${G.players[S2].name} die beste Karte.`;
  }

  function applyExchange(G, q, idxs) {
    const P = G.players;
    const cards = [...idxs].sort((a, b) => b - a).map(i => P[q.from].hand.splice(i, 1)[0]);
    P[q.to].hand.push(...cards);
    P[q.from].exInfo.gave.push({ who: P[q.to].name, cards });
    P[q.to].exInfo.got.push({ who: P[q.from].name, cards });
    sortHand(P[q.to].hand); sortHand(P[q.from].hand);
    G.exQueue.shift();
    if (G.exQueue.length) {
      G.msg = `${P[q.from].name} hat abgegeben.`;
    } else {
      G.msg = `Tausch abgeschlossen. ${G.players[G.lastRanking[0]].name} beginnt.`;
      startPlay(G, G.lastRanking[0]);
    }
  }

  function exchange(G, idx, idxs) {
    if (G.phase !== 'exchange') return 'Gerade ist kein Tausch.';
    const q = G.exQueue[0];
    if (idx !== q.from) return 'Du bist nicht dran.';
    if (!validIdx(idxs, G.players[idx].hand.length) || idxs.length !== q.count) return `Wähle genau ${q.count} Karte(n).`;
    applyExchange(G, q, idxs);
    return null;
  }

  // Spieler offline: die schwächsten Karten werden automatisch abgegeben
  function forceExchange(G, idx) {
    if (G.phase !== 'exchange') return;
    const q = G.exQueue[0];
    if (idx !== q.from) return;
    const len = G.players[idx].hand.length, idxs = [];
    for (let i = len - q.count; i < len; i++) idxs.push(i);
    G.msg = `${G.players[idx].name} ist offline: die schwächsten Karten werden abgegeben.`;
    applyExchange(G, q, idxs);
  }

  // ---- Spiel ----
  // Nach einem Zug geht es reihum weiter. Gepasste Spieler bleiben dabei.
  function advance(G, from) {
    G.current = nextActive(G, from);
  }

  // Der Spieler, der zuletzt gelegt hat, beendet den Stapel und eröffnet den nächsten.
  function closePile(G) {
    const leader = G.pile.last;
    G.pile = emptyPile(); G.pass = 0; G.current = leader;
    G.msg = `Stapel geräumt. ${G.players[leader].name} eröffnet den nächsten Stapel.`;
  }

  function endRound(G) {
    const rest = G.players.map((p, i) => i).filter(i => !G.players[i].finished);
    G.ranking = [...G.finishOrder, ...rest];
    G.phase = 'roundover'; G.current = null; G.pile = emptyPile();
    G.msg = `Runde ${G.round} beendet.`;
  }

  function play(G, idx, idxs) {
    if (G.phase !== 'play') return 'Gerade wird nicht gespielt.';
    if (idx !== G.current) return 'Du bist nicht am Zug.';
    const p = G.players[idx];
    if (!validIdx(idxs, p.hand.length)) return 'Ungültige Auswahl.';
    const cards = idxs.map(i => p.hand[i]);
    const rank = cards[0].r;
    if (cards.some(c => c.r !== rank)) return 'Nur Karten gleichen Werts gleichzeitig.';
    const k = cards.length;
    if (G.pile.count > 0) {
      if (k !== G.pile.count) return `Du musst genau ${G.pile.count} Karte(n) legen.`;
      if (strength(rank) < strength(G.pile.rank)) return 'Diese Karte ist zu schwach.';
    }
    const same = G.pile.count > 0 && rank === G.pile.rank;

    [...idxs].sort((a, b) => b - a).forEach(i => p.hand.splice(i, 1));
    sortHand(p.hand);
    G.msg = `${p.name} legt ${k}× ${rank}.`;

    if (p.hand.length === 0) { p.finished = true; G.finishOrder.push(idx); }
    if (G.players.filter(q => !q.finished).length <= 1) { endRound(G); return null; }

    // Ass oder letzte Karte beendet den Stapel sofort
    if (rank === 'A' || p.finished) {
      G.pile = emptyPile(); G.pass = 0;
      G.current = p.finished ? nextActive(G, idx) : idx;
      G.msg += rank === 'A' ? ' Das Ass räumt den Stapel ab.' : ' Letzte Karte: Der Stapel ist beendet.';
      return null;
    }

    G.pile = { cards, count: k, rank, last: idx };
    G.pass = 0;
    let from = idx;
    if (same) {
      from = nextActive(G, idx);
      G.msg += ` ${G.players[from].name} wird übersprungen.`;
    }
    advance(G, from);
    return null;
  }

  function pass(G, idx) {
    if (G.phase !== 'play') return 'Gerade wird nicht gespielt.';
    if (idx !== G.current) return 'Du bist nicht am Zug.';
    if (G.pile.count === 0) return 'Du musst eröffnen.';
    if (idx === G.pile.last) { closePile(G); return null; } // der letzte Leger passt: Stapel zu Ende
    G.msg = `${G.players[idx].name} passt.`;
    advance(G, idx);
    return null;
  }

  // Spieler offline und am Zug
  function forcePass(G, idx) {
    if (G.phase !== 'play' || idx !== G.current) return;
    if (G.pile.count > 0) {
      G.msg = `${G.players[idx].name} ist offline und wird übersprungen.`;
      if (idx === G.pile.last) closePile(G); else advance(G, idx);
    } else {
      G.current = nextActive(G, idx);
      G.msg = `${G.players[idx].name} ist offline, ${G.players[G.current].name} eröffnet.`;
    }
  }

  return { newEngine, startRound, nextRound, play, pass, forcePass, exchange, forceExchange, actor, RANKS, strength };
});

return module.exports;
})();

const HTML_B64 = '';
const HTML = Buffer.from(HTML_B64, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
const IDLE_MS = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // Party ohne Verbindung nach 2 Stunden löschen
const MAX_MEMBERS = 7;
const MIN_PLAYERS = 4;
const parties = new Map();

const randCode = () => {
  const a = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) s += a[crypto.randomInt(a.length)];
  return s;
};
const randToken = () => crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');

function uniqueName(P, base) {
  const name = (base || '').trim().slice(0, 20) || 'Spieler';
  let cand = name, n = 2;
  while (P.members.some(m => m.name.toLowerCase() === cand.toLowerCase())) cand = `${name} (${n++})`;
  return cand;
}

function addMember(P, name) {
  const m = { name: uniqueName(P, name), token: randToken(), sse: null, wins: 0, lasts: 0, rounds: 0 };
  P.members.push(m);
  return m;
}

function send(res, obj) {
  res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(obj)}\n\n`);
}

function json(res, status, obj) {
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' });
  res.end(JSON.stringify(obj));
}

function recordRound(P) {
  const r = P.G.ranking, n = r.length;
  P.members[r[0]].wins++;
  P.members[r[n - 1]].lasts++;
  r.forEach(i => P.members[i].rounds++);
}

// Offline-Spieler am Zug werden sofort übersprungen, bis ein Online-Spieler dran ist
function autoSkip(P) {
  if (P.status !== 'playing' || !P.G) return;
  for (let guard = 0; guard < 100; guard++) {
    const a = E.actor(P.G);
    if (a === null || P.members[a].sse) return;
    if (P.G.phase === 'exchange') E.forceExchange(P.G, a);
    else E.forcePass(P.G, a);
    if (P.G.phase === 'roundover') return;
  }
}

// Am Rundenende: Spieler, die immer noch offline sind, werden aus der Party entfernt
function kickOffline(P) {
  const G = P.G;
  const gone = P.members.filter(m => !m.sse);
  if (!gone.length) return;
  const keep = P.members.map((m, i) => i).filter(i => P.members[i].sse);
  const map = new Map(keep.map((old, nw) => [old, nw]));
  const names = gone.map(m => m.name).join(', ');
  G.players = keep.filter(i => i < G.players.length).map(i => G.players[i]);
  G.ranking = G.ranking.filter(i => map.has(i)).map(i => map.get(i));
  P.members = keep.map(i => P.members[i]);
  if (P.members.length < MIN_PLAYERS) {
    P.status = 'lobby';
    P.G = null;
    P.notice = `${names} wurde(n) entfernt, weil offline. Es sind zu wenige Spieler, die Party ist wieder in der Lobby.`;
  } else {
    P.notice = `${names} wurde(n) entfernt, weil offline.`;
  }
}

function view(P, i) {
  const G = P.G, m = P.members[i];
  const a = G ? E.actor(G) : null;
  const ex = G && G.phase === 'exchange' ? G.exQueue[0] : null;
  return {
    ver: P.ver,
    code: P.code,
    status: P.status,
    ended: P.status === 'ended',
    notice: P.notice || null,
    you: { idx: i, name: m.name, isHost: i === 0, pending: !!G && i >= G.players.length },
    members: P.members.map((x, j) => ({
      idx: j, name: x.name, connected: !!x.sse, isHost: j === 0,
      cards: G && G.players[j] ? G.players[j].hand.length : null,
      finished: !!(G && G.players[j] && G.players[j].finished),
      stats: { wins: x.wins, lasts: x.lasts, rounds: x.rounds }
    })),
    phase: G ? G.phase : 'lobby',
    round: G ? G.round : 0,
    msg: G ? G.msg : '',
    current: a,
    youAct: !!G && G.phase === 'play' && G.current === i,
    hand: G && G.players[i] ? G.players[i].hand.map(c => ({ r: c.r, s: c.s })) : [],
    exInfo: G && G.players[i] ? G.players[i].exInfo : { got: [], gave: [] },
    pile: G ? { cards: G.pile.cards.map(c => ({ r: c.r, s: c.s })), rank: G.pile.rank, count: G.pile.count } : { cards: [], rank: null, count: 0 },
    exchange: ex ? { from: G.players[ex.from].name, to: G.players[ex.to].name, count: ex.count, youGive: ex.from === i } : null,
    ranking: G && G.phase === 'roundover' ? G.ranking.map(j => P.members[j].name) : null
  };
}

function sync(P) {
  autoSkip(P);
  if (P.G && P.G.phase === 'roundover' && P.recorded !== P.G.round) {
    recordRound(P);
    P.recorded = P.G.round;
    kickOffline(P);
  }
  P.ver = (P.ver || 0) + 1;
  P.lastActive = Date.now();
  P.members.forEach((m, i) => { if (m.sse) send(m.sse, view(P, i)); });
}

function handleCreate(body, res) {
  let c;
  do { c = randCode(); } while (parties.has(c));
  const P = { code: c, status: 'lobby', members: [], G: null, lastActive: Date.now(), ver: 0, recorded: null, notice: null };
  parties.set(c, P);
  const m = addMember(P, body.name);
  sync(P);
  json(res, 200, { code: c, token: m.token });
}

function handleJoin(body, res) {
  const P = parties.get(String(body.code || '').toUpperCase());
  if (!P) return json(res, 404, { error: 'Party nicht gefunden.' });
  if (P.status === 'ended') return json(res, 400, { error: 'Diese Party ist beendet.' });
  if (P.members.length >= MAX_MEMBERS) return json(res, 400, { error: 'Die Party ist voll (7 Spieler).' });
  const m = addMember(P, body.name);
  sync(P);
  json(res, 200, { code: P.code, token: m.token });
}

function handleEvents(req, res, url) {
  const P = parties.get((url.searchParams.get('code') || '').toUpperCase());
  const tok = url.searchParams.get('token');
  const m = P && P.members.find(x => x.token === tok);
  if (!m) return json(res, 404, { error: 'Party oder Spieler nicht gefunden.' });
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', Connection: 'keep-alive' });
  res.write('retry: 2000\n\n');
  if (m.sse) m.sse.end();
  m.sse = res;
  const ping = setInterval(() => res.write(': ping\n\n'), 20000);
  sync(P);
  req.on('close', () => {
    clearInterval(ping);
    if (m.sse === res) { m.sse = null; sync(P); }
  });
}

function handleAction(body, res) {
  const P = parties.get(String(body.code || '').toUpperCase());
  const m = P && P.members.find(x => x.token === body.token);
  if (!m) return json(res, 404, { error: 'Party oder Spieler nicht gefunden.' });
  if (P.status === 'ended') return json(res, 400, { error: 'Die Party ist beendet.' });
  const i = P.members.indexOf(m);
  const idxs = body.idxs || [];
  let err = null;

  switch (body.type) {
    case 'start':
      if (i !== 0) err = 'Nur der Host kann starten.';
      else if (P.status !== 'lobby') err = 'Das Spiel läuft schon.';
      else if (P.members.length < MIN_PLAYERS) err = 'Mindestens 4 Spieler sind nötig.';
      else {
        P.G = E.newEngine(P.members.map(x => x.name));
        P.status = 'playing';
        P.notice = null;
        E.startRound(P.G);
      }
      break;
    case 'play': err = P.G ? E.play(P.G, i, idxs) : 'Es läuft kein Spiel.'; break;
    case 'pass': err = P.G ? E.pass(P.G, i) : 'Es läuft kein Spiel.'; break;
    case 'exchange': err = P.G ? E.exchange(P.G, i, idxs) : 'Es läuft kein Spiel.'; break;
    case 'nextRound':
      if (i !== 0) err = 'Nur der Host kann die nächste Runde starten.';
      else if (!P.G || P.G.phase !== 'roundover') err = 'Die Runde läuft noch.';
      else { P.notice = null; E.nextRound(P.G, P.members.slice(P.G.players.length).map(x => x.name)); }
      break;
    case 'end':
      if (i !== 0) err = 'Nur der Host kann die Party beenden.';
      else P.status = 'ended';
      break;
    case 'leave':
      if (P.status !== 'lobby') err = 'Verlassen ist nur in der Lobby möglich.';
      else {
        P.members.splice(i, 1);
        if (m.sse) m.sse.end();
        if (!P.members.length) { parties.delete(P.code); return json(res, 200, { ok: true }); }
      }
      break;
    default: err = 'Unbekannte Aktion.';
  }

  if (err) return json(res, 400, { error: err });
  sync(P);
  json(res, 200, { ok: true });
}

function readBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let d = '';
    req.on('data', c => { d += c; if (d.length > 100000) req.destroy(); });
    req.on('end', () => { try { resolve(d ? JSON.parse(d) : {}); } catch (e) { reject(e); } });
  });
}

function sendFile(res, file, type) {
  fs.readFile(path.join(__dirname, file), (err, data) => {
    if (err) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Nicht gefunden'); }
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': type });
    res.end(data);
  });
}

// Parties ohne Verbindung und ohne Aktivität aufräumen
setInterval(() => {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [c, P] of parties) {
    const alive = P.members.some(m => m.sse);
    if (!alive && now - P.lastActive > IDLE_MS) parties.delete(c);
  }
}, 60000).unref();

http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost');
  try {
    if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/') { res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' }); return res.end(HTML); }
    if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/api/events') return handleEvents(req, res, url);
    if (req.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/api/create') return handleCreate(await readBody(req), res);
    if (req.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/api/join') return handleJoin(await readBody(req), res);
    if (req.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/api/action') return handleAction(await readBody(req), res);
    res.writeHead(404); res.end('Nicht gefunden');
  } catch (e) {
    if (!res.headersSent) json(res, 400, { error: 'Ungültige Anfrage.' });
  }
}).listen(PORT, () => console.log(`Kartenspiel-Server läuft auf Port ${PORT}`));
